steps.en: Officer opens the ad-hoc query page
steps.why_en: The page is switched off and cannot be opened
steps.why_id: Halaman dimatikan sehingga tidak bisa dibuka

steps.en: Officer enters vehicle number and offence date
steps.id: Officer mengisi vehicle number dan offence date
steps.why_en: No form or request exists for a single lookup
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form atau request untuk satu pencarian

steps.en: Vehicle number and offence date go to the agency in a batch file
steps.id: Vehicle number dan offence date dikirim ke agensi lewat file batch
steps.why_en: Sent twice daily for existing notices, not on demand by the officer
steps.why_id: Dikirim dua kali sehari untuk notice yang ada, bukan atas permintaan officer

steps.en: Ownership comes back from the agency and shows on the notice
steps.id: Ownership kembali dari agensi dan tampil di notice
steps.why_en: Shown per notice after the batch, not as an answer to the officer's query; some notices never get ownership
steps.why_id: Tampil per notice setelah batch, bukan jawaban query officer; sebagian notice tidak pernah dapat ownership
